public_api.policy_boundary: internal execution settings and CLI configuration

strict.scope: Direct CPU reference, same compiler identity, precision, and plan version
strict.restart: step 0 to 100 equals step 0 to 50 save/reload/resume to 100 on the same rank count

fast.restart: numerical tolerance is required; bitwise equality is not advertised

restart_state.compiler: exact compiler family and version identity
restart_state.math_mode: execution mode plus per-backend FMA and reduction policies
restart_state.payload: V1 serializes particle state only; complete portable state is specified by P9/OPS-002

snapshot_boundary.mpi_in_flight: all nonblocking communication represented by MpiContext is forbidden
snapshot_boundary.publication: capture only after the simulation reports no active MPI communication

distributed_restart.current: same source and destination rank count only
distributed_restart.rank_count_change: planned in P9/OPS-002 with global bounds, source domains, and ownership metadata

acceptance.strict_restart: byte-identical final snapshot and compatible manifest
acceptance.fast_disclosure: metadata bitwise_reproducible is false and backend is runtime-selected before execution
acceptance.boundary: active MPI communication rejects snapshot capture
acceptance.portable_snapshot_state: owned by P9/OPS-002 rather than the V1 particle payload
